policy_snapshot_info: Changes apply to future agreements. Reservations with captured terms retain their previous policy.
default_policy_active: This is the default policy for the house. Clear or replace the selection before deactivating it.
policy_rules_help: Add 1 to 100 tiers with unique advance-day thresholds, including 0. The refund percentage allows up to two decimals.
archived_property: Archived house: history and outstanding money settlement remain available. Reactivate the house for new reservations or active collaborators.

configuration_future_only: Usual times and amounts are offered for new reservations; recorded agreements are unchanged.
archive_property_confirm: Archiving prevents new records and confirmations. Reservations and history remain. Outstanding receipts, refunds and expenses can be settled under current rules.
policy_toggle_confirm: Changing status does not alter terms captured by previous reservations. Clear a default policy from configuration before deactivating it.
collaborator_toggle_confirm: Changing {{name}}'s access preserves authorship of their records. Removing them prevents further management of this house.
validation_length: The text exceeds the allowed length.
validation_amount: Enter a positive whole CLP amount within the allowed limit.
validation_percent: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 with up to two decimals.
validation_integer: Enter a whole number within the allowed range.
validation_timezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, such as America/Santiago.
validation_time: Enter a valid time in HH:mm format.
validation_rules: Define 1 to 100 unique tiers and a tier for 0 days.
void_money_hint: Voids the complete record and retains history. The server verifies the deposit and approved refund.
expense_pay_hint: Record the full payment completed on the selected date.
expense_void_hint: Void the entire expense and retain its history.
payment_effective_hint: Record only money already received or refunded. This does not execute an external payment or transfer.
direct_policy_required: Configure a cancellation policy and a deposit before recording the first payment.
platform_policy_hint: The first payment freezes the Airbnb terms recorded manually.
immutable_payment_hint: Amount and date cannot be edited. To correct an eligible record, void it completely.
paid_expense_hint: A paid expense only allows changes to descriptive information and its associated reservation.
overview_scope: Cash flow uses effective dates for payments, refunds and paid expenses. Pending amounts cover all current property records, regardless of the selected period.
overview_cash_hint: Net cash flow is not accounting profit. Airbnb payments already account for its commission.
sample_limit: Sample of up to 10 records. Open the list to view all.
audit_safe_hint: Read-only history. Sensitive information is omitted.
cash_period_invalid: Select a period of 1 to 366 days
payment_unavailable: This reservation does not allow this monetary record
future_date: The date cannot be in the future
cancelled_date_hint: The refund date cannot precede cancellation.
paired_period: Enter both dates and a valid period of up to 366 days.
quote_explanation: A quote does not hold dates. Charges use nights and times in {{timezone}}.
agreement_locked: Confirmation or money history has frozen the agreement. Contact, notes and archive can still be edited.
history_unavailable: Money history could not be verified. Commercial fields remain protected.
instant_with_offset: Use an ISO date and time with an explicit offset, for example 2026-10-01T15:00:00-03:00.
archive_occupancy_explanation: Archiving preserves history and occupied dates of confirmed, started or completed stays. Cancel when permitted to release dates.
cancellation_record_summary: Cancellation recorded {{days}} days before. Approved refund: {{refund}}.
same_day_explanation: Review affected turnovers. Consent is sent with confirmation and the server validates the complete transition.
no_same_day_requirements: No same-day turnover reviews in this check.
prospective_plan_warning: The current transition may change upon confirmation. Review the planned time; the server determines compatibility.
consent_same_day: I approve the same-day turnover for plan #{{id}}
save_draft_before_review: Save the draft before reviewing its preparation.
availability_not_hold: Availability checks do not hold dates. Confirmation validates conflicts and turnovers together.
direct_deposit_required: To confirm a direct reservation, select a policy, agree a positive deposit and record its receipt.
platform_manual_explanation: Record Airbnb conditions manually. This action does not synchronize with or charge the platform.
cancel_explanation: Review the calculation first. Cancellation releases dates and approves a refund; record the actual transfer separately.
review_cancel_amount: I have reviewed the conditions and refund amount
start_requirements: Starting requires the agreed time, available linen, completed cleaning and recorded actual readiness. The server validates state on submission.
complete_requirements: Completion can be recorded once the agreed checkout time is reached. The server verifies timing.
expired_unstarted_stay: This stay expired without a recorded start. The current version does not support retroactive adjustment.
actual_preparation_required: Complete and record actual readiness before starting. Future approval does not prove completed cleaning.
block_explanation: Block an interval of instants; an inactive block releases availability. House timezone: {{timezone}}.
preparation_explanation: Record linen, cleaning and times in {{timezone}}. Planned readiness does not replace actual completion.
preparation_changes_warning: Changes to linen, timing or neighboring stays can invalidate approvals. Save the plan first and review its current state.
calendar_legend: Cards show occupied nights and agreed times. Archiving does not release occupancy; quotes and cancellations show their status. Use the agenda to review all events.
calendar_window_error: The complete calendar could not be loaded. Retry or reduce the period.
empty_calendar: No reservations, blocks or turnovers in this period.
not_ready: To record completed preparation, confirm that linen is available, cleaning is completed and the actual ready time is not in the future.
invalid_period: Enter a valid period of up to 366 days.
exclusive_period: The end date is excluded. Maximum 366 days.
archive_warning: Archived house: history, payments, refunds and expenses remain available. Reactivate it for new agreements.
property_empty: You have no available houses yet. Create your house to begin.
empty_changes: There are no additional changes to display.
visibility_confirm: This change updates record visibility. Save the form to apply it; history is preserved.
airbnb_reference_required: Add the Airbnb reservation external reference in its record before confirming or recording payments.
